title: Add a bun run check script that runs lint, typecheck and tests
description: Contributors and the factory's own agents run three commands to check the repo (bun run lint, bun run typecheck, bun test). Add one package.json script, check, that runs all three in that order and stops at the first failure. Mention it in the Commands table in README.md and the Commands list in CLAUDE.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Running bun run check on main's code exits 0 and its output shows biome lint, tsc --noEmit and bun test each ran (proof: live)
bun run check exits non-zero when the typecheck fails, for example after adding const x: number = "a" to a factory .ts file (proof: live)
README.md's Commands table and CLAUDE.md's Commands list each name bun run check (proof: manual)
